text: hana: Quick poll: in the Connect settings form do we show an asterisk only, 'Required' pill, or visible '(required)' after label? trying to balance density vs clarity. jorge: asterisk only for most fields. it's compact and familiar. but need SR fallback. kevin: +1 for asterisk + visually-hidden text. example: required. aria-required too. abby: thought: what about showing 'Optional' for fields that are optional instead of marking required? reduces repetition of markings. hana: product asked for minimal labels on sign-up flows. but some enterprise forms are dense and the pills look terrible. jorge: implementation note: if we use pill we must ensure color contrast. pills are extra DOM elements so forms become heavier. kevin: on errors — do we prefer inline under field or toast/summary only? i think inline under field + linkable summary when multiple errors on submit. anchor to first invalid field. abby: accessibility nit: when the form is submitted with errors, focus should move to the summary and the SR should announce it. use role="alert" or aria-live. a11y-bot: accessibility checklist item created: https://tracker.redwood/a11y/1782 (test NVDA/JAWS with updated DOM) hana: what about destructive actions confirmation? delete connector currently uses typed-confirm. it's overkill for removing a test connector. maybe checkbox confirm for non-prod, typed-confirm for prod. jorge: agree. typed-confirm reserved for things that cascade or charge customers. checkbox + explicit microcopy otherwise. trap focus + aria-modal on the modal. kevin: i'll draft a small patterns doc: - show asterisk for visual brevity - add visually-hidden 'required' for SRs - optional fields: show 'Optional' inline if it helps clarity, otherwise leave blank - inline errors below fields; summary at top for multi-error submit with links - announce errors via aria-live/role=alert and move focus to summary - use checkbox confirm for low-risk deletes; typed-confirm only for high-risk abby: pls add a code snippet for the live region to the doc (offscreen container with aria-live="polite"/"assertive"). i'll pair to test on NVDA next Wed. hana: i'll update the figma and post the RFC with copy examples. thanks all :)
